verdict.rationale: Buzz exposes programmatic surfaces (a Nostr relay protocol, REST, an admin API and a CLI), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no such reference: all OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404, and the repo documents its protocol only as markdown NIP drafts, with no machine-readable API spec and no runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
